title: 第13章 入我仙庭保你无恙第14章 我要你答应我
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
【恭喜宿主获得诸天第一体质：不死神躯，诸天第一神瞳：灭生圣瞳，以及破空符+5（可无视世间所有力量破空而去）】
“不死神躯，灭生圣瞳，破空符……”忆无情暗暗思索，这些东西只有破空符他听说过，其他都没有听说过。
但一听就知道很厉害。
【宿主现在是否选择融合？】
闻言，忆无情看了看一旁的柳梦兮，随即道：“算了，到了外界在融合吧，你先把破空符咒拿来。”
【收到。】
忆无情面前出现了五张看起来普普通通的符咒，除了浑身发着光就没什么特别的了。
但忆无情可不这么认为，破空符在外界虽然也有，但远远不如系统给的这个，无视世间所有力量破空而去，这也太逆天了。
将破空符收回之后，忆无情问道：“系统为何你没有系统空间，人家的系统都有。”
【什么系统空间？还想让本系统帮你保存物品，想得美。】
系统软萌傲娇的声音响起。
“额……”忆无情无奈，这系统真的皮，若是它是个人自己必然要好好教训一番。
“梦兮。”忆无情看向柳梦兮，道：“我们出去吧。”
柳梦兮转过脑袋，将手中的剑还给忆无情，拉着他的手，笑盈盈道：“快出去，快出去，师尊见了你肯定很开心。”
忆无情微微一笑，他也很期待如今的仙界如何了，他在里面时没有问其他人仙界具体的状况，只简单听说了一些，因为他想亲眼去看看如今的仙界，究竟如何了。
“十万载，算是一个大时代过去了，我也算是老一辈的人了。”忆无情感叹一声。
“才不算，无情现在还很年轻呢，人家摸你手的时候感觉到你现在才不过两百岁呢。”柳梦兮望着忆无情，笑颜如花。
“是，我还年轻，好了，我们出去吧。”忆无情微微一笑，带着走到了出口处。
忆无情最后看了一眼通天古路，毅然走进出口。
“通天古路，我的前半生都在你这度过，但我的后半生……大概不会再回来了。”

……
“可恶！为何看不到其中场景了！还未到三日！”
“我教传人到底被那忆无情怎么了！”
“忆无情！欺人太甚！当年欺负我等还不够，这次还要对我等后辈出手！”
“八嘎！”
通天古路外众人已经开始破口大骂了，但没人敢动手。
“快看！有人出来了！”
闻言，众人齐齐望去，想看看是不是自己家的传人。
光芒散去，众人纷纷瞪大双眼，不可置信。
“忆忆忆……忆无情！！！”
只见光芒散去，两道身影出现，正是忆无情与柳梦兮。
“各位，好久不见。”忆无情脸上露出一副灿烂无比的笑容。
这一刻，场上出现片刻沉默，但很快，众人反应过来。
“哈哈哈！忆无情！你死期到了！”
“忆无情！死！”
刹那间，无数只大手向着忆无情袭来，天空都暗沉下来。
content_en:
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the number one physique in the world: the Immortal God Body, the number one pupil in the world: the Holy Eye of Death, and the Sky Breaking Talisman +5 (can ignore all the power in the world and break through the sky)]
"Immortal God Body, Life-Destroying Holy Eyes, Sky-Breaking Talisman..." Yi Qingqing thought secretly. He had only heard of these things, the Sky-Breaking Talisman, but not the others.
But as soon as I heard it, I knew it was awesome.
[Does the host choose to fuse now? 】
Hearing this, Yi Qingqing looked at Liu Mengxi on the side, and then said: "Forget it, the outside world is merging. You can bring the Sky Breaking Talisman first."
[Received. 】
Five ordinary-looking talismans appeared in front of Yi Qingqing. There was nothing special about them except that they were all glowing.
But Yi Qingqing doesn't think so. Although there are sky-breaking talismans in the outside world, they are far inferior to the ones given by the system. It is too unnatural to ignore all the power in the world and break through the sky.
After taking back the Sky Breaking Talisman, Yi Qingqing asked: "System, why don't you have system space? Other people's systems have it."
[What system space? You also want this system to help you save items, which is a good idea. 】
The system's cute and arrogant voice sounded.
"Uh..." Yi Qingqing was helpless. This system is really ugly. If it were an individual, he would definitely have to teach him a lesson.
"Mengxi." Yi Qingqing looked at Liu Mengxi and said, "Let's go out."
Liu Mengxi turned her head, returned the sword in her hand to Yi Qingqing, took his hand, and said with a smile: "Get out quickly, get out quickly, Master will be very happy to see you."
Yi Qingqing smiled slightly. He was also looking forward to how the fairy world is now. When he was inside, he did not ask others about the specific situation of the fairy world. He only briefly heard about it because he wanted to see with his own eyes how the fairy world is now.
"One hundred thousand years, a big era has passed, and I can be considered a member of the older generation." Yiwu sighed.
"No, Wu Qing is still very young now. When I touch your hand, I feel that you are only two hundred years old." Liu Mengxi looked at Yi Qingqing with a smile like a flower.
"Yes, I'm still young. Okay, let's go out." Yi Wuwu smiled slightly and led him to the exit.
Yi Wuqing took one last look at the Tongtian Ancient Road and resolutely walked into the exit.
"Tongtian Ancient Road, I spent the first half of my life with you, but the second half of my life... I probably won't come back."
…
"Damn it! Why can't I see the scene? It's not even three days yet!"
"What happened to the heir of my teaching who was so cruel by Na Yi?"
"Yi Qingqing! Bullying goes too far! It wasn't enough to bully me and others back then, this time I have to take action against me and other juniors!"
"Baga!"
Everyone outside Tongtian Ancient Road had begun to curse, but no one dared to take action.
"Look! Someone is coming out!"
Hearing this, everyone looked together to see if he was a descendant of their own family.
The light dissipated, and everyone's eyes widened in disbelief.
"Yi Yi Yi... Yi Qing Wu!!!"
The light dissipated and two figures appeared, it was Yi Qingqing and Liu Mengxi.
"Everyone, long time no see." A bright smile appeared on Yi Wuqing's face.
At this moment, there was a moment of silence on the field, but soon everyone reacted.
"Hahaha! Yi Qingqing! It's your time to die!"
"Yi Wuqing! Die!"
In an instant, countless big hands attacked Yi Qingqing, and the sky darkened.
